validation.amount: Enter an amount like 25 or 25.50 — numbers only, up to two decimals.
validation.nothing: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.moreCod: That is more COD than is available to submit.
validation.moreFee: That is more in delivery fees than is available to submit.
validation.moreThanSubmitted: You can’t confirm more than was submitted.
validation.disputeReason: Give a reason for the dispute (at least 5 characters).

submit.description: Enter what you are handing over to {recipient}. COD and delivery fees are kept apart.
submit.reserves: This amount is reserved, not cleared: it stays on your balance until {recipient} counts the cash and confirms it.
submit.permanent: The submission gets a reference number and is kept permanently.
submit.submitted: {number} submitted ({amount}). It clears once it is confirmed.
submit.nothingAvailable: Nothing to submit right now: all the cash you hold is already submitted or confirmed.

review.confirmDescription: {name} submitted {amount}. Count the cash, then enter what you received.
review.discrepancy: You counted {counted} of {submitted}. The submission is kept as it was and marked disputed; {counted} is recorded as received and the difference stays on their balance.
review.audit: Your name, the time and the amounts are recorded permanently.
review.recordedDiscrepancy: {number}: {amount} recorded as received; the difference stays outstanding.
review.disputeDescription: Nothing is counted as received. The {amount} stays on their balance, and they can submit again once it is sorted out.

weeks.note: Weeks run Monday to Sunday, UAE time. A new week opens with what was still held at the end of the last one — balances carry over, never reset.

driver.title: Cash Remittance
driver.intro: The cash you collected, what you’ve handed to an operator, and what you still hold. Your balance only goes down when an operator counts the cash and confirms it.
driver.loadFailed: Unable to load your cash. Please try again.

cards.weekNote: Cash you confirmed collecting this week. COD is the customers’ money for their goods, kept apart from ParcelLink’s delivery fees.

driver.outstandingSplit: Of what you hold: COD {cod}, delivery fees {fee}.
driver.carried: {amount} was carried over from earlier weeks.
driver.pendingNote: {count, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}} ({amount}) awaiting an operator’s confirmation — still on your balance.
driver.disputedNote: {count, plural, one {# submission was} other {# submissions were}} disputed. That cash is still on your balance; submit again once it is sorted out.
driver.unclassifiedNote: {amount} was recorded by staff without a COD/fee split; it is taken off your total balance.
driver.expectedNote: {amount} is still to collect on deliveries in progress — not cash you hold yet.
driver.unverifiedNote: {amount} was collected before amounts were recorded and isn’t in the balance. Ask operations about it.
driver.availableLine: Available to submit: COD {cod}, delivery fees {fee}.

operator.title: Cash Remittances
operator.intro: Confirm the cash drivers hand you, then submit it to the manager each week. Cash you confirm becomes yours to account for until the manager confirms receiving it.
operator.loadFailed: Unable to load cash remittances. Please try again.
operator.queueNote: {count, plural, one {# driver submission is} other {# driver submissions are}} waiting to be counted.
operator.weekLine: This week ({period}): {received} received from drivers, {confirmed} confirmed by the manager.
operator.outstandingSplit: Of what you hold: COD {cod}, delivery fees {fee}.
operator.carried: {amount} was carried over from earlier weeks.
operator.pendingNote: {count, plural, one {# remittance} other {# remittances}} ({amount}) awaiting the manager’s confirmation — still on your balance.
operator.disputedNote: {count, plural, one {# remittance was} other {# remittances were}} disputed by the manager. That cash is still on your balance.
operator.otherNote: Only cash you confirmed from drivers counts here. A driver’s submission you haven’t confirmed isn’t yours yet; ParcelLink records no other cash for operators.
operator.availableLine: Available to submit: COD {cod}, delivery fees {fee}.
operator.historyEmpty: No remittances to the manager yet.

manager.title: Cash Remittances
manager.intro: Cash operators hand you each week, and where every dirham drivers collected is right now. Each amount is counted once: with a driver, then an operator, then you.
manager.loadFailed: Unable to load cash remittances. Please try again.
manager.queueNote: {count, plural, one {# operator remittance} other {# operator remittances}} ({amount}) waiting for you to count.
manager.splitLine: Received from operators: COD {cod}, delivery fees {fee}. COD is merchants’ money, paid out through their statements — not ParcelLink revenue.
manager.balancesEmpty: No operator has received cash yet.
manager.driverNote: Operators normally count these. If you count one yourself, the cash is with you and doesn’t go through an operator’s balance.
